correctness.rationale: The search covers all 512^2 ordered binary transition-relation pairs. Breadth-first closure from the identity is the complete word-product monoid. An automaton is rejected as ambiguous exactly when an ordinary integer product develops an entry above one. For the remaining automata, distance to the zero matrix is the exact shortest killing length. The full histogram sums to 7,699 mortal UFAs and peaks at 6 with twelve labeled extremizers. Boolean-relation composition independently agrees with every zero-one integer product, and direct word replay proves that the canonical representative is not killed below length 6 but is killed by abaaba.

value.rationale: Sharp killing-word length is the central invariant of the cited UFA mortality literature, where general bounds leave a polynomial-versus-quadratic gap. The three-state binary case is the first compact fixed-alphabet instance where exhaustive resolution is feasible yet nontrivial. The result closes that instance exactly and adds structural rigidity: nondeterminism gives no extremal advantage, and all twelve labeled maximizers collapse to one transitive partial-deterministic class.
